claims: Installing a capacitor with a higher value can cause the fan motor to overheat and burn out.
A capacitor with a lower value will result in slow fan speed and insufficient torque to start.
Using the wrong capacitor rating can damage the internal windings of the ceiling fan motor.

claims.text: Installing a wrong capacitance value in a motor can cause uneven rotation, increased energy consumption, and overheating.
Using the wrong microfarad rating on a ceiling fan can make the fan slow or overheat.
